set.body:
Make the general NIfTI path allocation-bounded and suitable for representative medical/fMRI datasets while preserving one Ravel owner.

Requirements
- Decode directly into an owned Ravel builder/buffer or another Ravel-authorized consuming API.
- Avoid the simultaneous full file byte array plus Array[Double] plus final NDArray pattern.
- Preserve explicit byte-order and NIfTI first-axis-fastest to logical-order conversion.
- Stream gzip where practical; map/chunk support belongs in Ravel and must not create another image container.
- Keep raw dtype or explicit conversion throughout.
- Define supported maximum sizes and typed overflow/resource failures.
- Write paths receive corresponding allocation scrutiny.

Acceptance criteria
- Uncompressed representative 3D/4D reads require the final output plus only a documented bounded working set, not another full decoded image.
- Compressed reads use a documented bounded buffer strategy.
- Logical checksums match the current independent file-order oracle.
- No raw storage escape or parallel image buffer hierarchy is added.

Tests
- Allocation/peak-memory courts for Float32 3D, Float32 4D fMRI, integer labels, and gzip variants.
- Matched logical and weighted checksums against independent reference fixtures.
- Truncation at every payload boundary, overflow dimensions, short reads, and malformed headers return typed failures.
- Endian/dtype differential tests and large round trips.
- JVM and Node.js tests where platform support exists; browser filesystem support is not implied.
- Performance numbers are source/runtime fingerprinted and are not release claims without a quiescent matched run.
set.title: Build an allocation-bounded production NIfTI codec
